```
  "scored_at": "2026-04-01T10:00:00Z"
}
```

**Reading (GET):** Returns the email addresses of all users who have visibility of this job at the job level (i.e. not through company-wide visibility).

**Writing (POST/PUT):** Sets job visibility to exactly the list of emails provided. This is a **full replacement** — you must include every user who should have job level visibility, not just new additions.

> ⚠️ **Any user whose email is omitted from the array will have their job level visibility removed.**. This is an extra attribute. If you want it to be returned please add `extra_fields` query param (see Query Params section)
